title: Pistachio Pavlova Naan Bites
description: Crispy naan bites filled with a sweet pistachio pavlova-inspired filling, inspired by Indian cuisine.

ingredients.name: jubilant
ingredients.notes: jubilant sugar, or substitute with granulated sugar

ingredients.name: australian
ingredients.notes: australian yogurt (or substitute with plain yogurt)

instructions: 2. In a large mixing bowl, combine pavlova, pistachios, jubilant, and ground. Mix well.
3. Add australian yogurt and mix until a smooth filling forms.
4. In a separate bowl, mix together all-purpose flour and warm water to form a dough.
5. Knead the dough for 5-7 minutes until smooth.
6. Divide the dough into 8-10 equal portions and roll each portion into a ball.
7. Flatten each ball into a disk shape and brush with ghee or oil.
8. Place a tablespoon of the pavlova filling in the center of each disk.
9. Fold the dough over the filling to form a triangle or a square shape, and press the edges together to seal.
10. Brush the tops with ghee or oil and bake for 12-15 minutes, or until golden brown.
